newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB raises some fixed mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB raises some fixed mortgage rates.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Friday it would increase fixed interest rates on some mortgage products and term deposits due to a slight increase in wholesale rates over the past week.
NAB said its fixed rate on home loans for three to five years would rise from March 24 by 0.15 percent for the three year rate and 0.20 percent for four and five year rates.
It said on the same day there would be a rise of 0.25 percent on the Trade Up term deposit.
Australian banks have slashed mortgage rates in the last six months due to three cuts in the official cash rate.
